[EN] If Thulsa's really behind all this, it would explain the Ksharans we've gotten word of.

Arast at Dusk Camp said he saw a Ksharan near his post. Ksharans are undead made through argon artifice. They're definitely a threat.

Confirm their presence and report to Arast directly.
[ES] Si Thulsa realmente está detrás de todo esto, explicaría los Ksharans de los que hemos tenido noticias.

Arast en Dusk Camp dijo que vio a un Ksharan cerca de su puesto. Los Ksharans son muertos vivientes creados mediante artificio argon. Definitivamente son una amenaza.

Confirma su presencia e infórmale a Arast directamente.

[EN] These are definitely Thulsan amulets. Thulsa's cast his net wide and gathered numerous allies to shield his work.

That explains why the unseelie are so bold. They think Thulsa will support them. Fools.

Thulsa's only loyalty is to himself.
[ES] Estos son definitivamente amuletos de Thulsa. Thulsa ha lanzado su red ampliamente y ha reunido numerosos aliados para proteger su trabajo.

Eso explica por qué los unseelie son tan audaces. Piensan que Thulsa los apoyará. Insensatos.

La única lealtad de Thulsa es hacia sí mismo.

[EN] I must know if the roads are safe. Please ensure they're clear or bring something tangible we can share with command.
[ES] Debo saber si los caminos son seguros. Por favor, asegúrate de que estén despejados o trae algo tangible que podamos compartir con el mando.
